classification.difficultyReason: Apply the tangent–secant product rule, then subtract the external intercept from the whole secant.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: External point L with tangent LK extended beyond K and secant L–M–N. Ordinary source-coloured outlines are reconstructed in house black; no shading or additional construction marks.
spec.mathematics: K is the point of tangency. L, M and N are collinear in that order. LN is the whole secant. Coordinate-derived tangency satisfies LK² = LM × LN.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and point labels are visible; computed lengths remain in answer fields.

answer.worked:
Tangent–secant product rule:
$$\begin{align*}LK^2 &= LM\times LN\\12^2 &= LM\times16\\LM &= \frac{144}{16}\\LM &= 9\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}MN &= LN-LM\\MN &= 16-9\\MN &= 7\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
